name: android-texter
description: Send and read SMS and MMS from your own Android phone and number. Texts go out over your phone's carrier plan, and replies come back into your Android Texter account.

api_key.title: Android Texter API key
api_key.description: Create one in the dashboard under Settings > API Keys (https://androidtexter.com/dashboard/settings/api-keys). Keys start with atx_.
